description.value:
One per gun. Takes any Gun Shield: it works as a Bulletproof Shield while the gun is held two-handed and you haven't moved more than 4m this Round. Deploy or retract it as an Action, or while stowing the gun or setting a Bipod. Deployed, it's not concealable; no Popup Weapon. A destroyed shield is gone for good; a new one takes 1 minute to fit.

Cost: 100eb
Fits: All Ranged Weapons except Bows
